records.title: Failure of NRA to conduct CET
details: NRA is conducting a detailed study of the prevalent recruitment systems in Central and State Governments and the procedure followed by various Public Examination Authorities (PEAs) for conduct of examination and also examining the issues which are likely to arise in the New exam system and address them ab initio so as to conduct a free and fair examination. NRA is also in the process of developing protocols and policy frameworks to address various issues associated with conduct of new exam system as well as evolving effective means for ensuring compliance of Normative Standards and Guidelines by all concerned.
